# Full-catalog acceleration matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/render-acceleration-matrix.py; edit the catalog, then regenerate. -->

Source: [schema-2 catalog](../catalog/audio-104.json); identity/order checked against the [independent fixture](../tests/audio-catalog-identities.json). No network, Nix evaluation, model acquisition or hardware probing occurs during rendering.

**104** canonical repositories; **99** complete assessments; **5** blocked-evidence; **0** pending; **98** backend records; **16** packaged and **88** catalog-only repositories.

Packaged delivery scopes: **12** native-plugin; **4** windows-artifacts. Windows ZIP/NSIS delivery does not establish native Linux installability. Additional attributes do not add repository rows. Source builds and cache realization are distinguished in the linked delivery evidence; older backend source assessments retain their own revision and proof boundaries.

AI roles (computed from the authoritative catalog, not inferred from product names): `external-service`: 2; `inference`: 6; `mixed`: 5; `none`: 86; `unknown`: 5.

Backend records are component/platform/architecture/vendor/provider assessments, not delivered accelerated packages and not all neural inference. They also cover non-neural GPU DSP, unsupported routes and port work. Repository-level catalog-only counts must not be read as a count of neural plugins awaiting acceleration.

Published package attributes and backend package attributes are separate. A `null` backend attribute does not publish a GPU alias, even when a private recipe override evaluated. Evaluation, linked build and shared-library load do not establish model execution, provider placement or host/audio acceptance. AMD hardware stages are policy-skipped. See [validation and limitations](acceleration-validation.md).

## Rights, evidence and next actions

Rights metadata is informational and not a technical implementation gate. Consumers own use/distribution decisions; AI labels grant no copyright exemption. Models and drivers are user-owned: no automatic model downloads or driver activation are implied. Native packaging is independent of any custom Wine/installer framework.
